subject: Social Media
title: The Streisand Effect
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Streisand Effect.

hook.text: Barbra Streisand sued to remove a photo of her house. Before the suit: six views. After: 420,000.

buildup.text: Trying to suppress information online almost always backfires. Suppression creates curiosity.

discovery.text: The Streisand Effect: attempting to hide something draws more attention to it than ignoring it would.

twist.text: Governments trigger it constantly. Banning a book makes it a bestseller. Censoring a post makes it famous.

climax.text: The internet treats censorship as damage and routes around it—as cyberpunk pioneer John Gilmore said.

punchline.text: Try to hide it and the internet shows everyone.

quiz.question: What is the Streisand Effect?
options: Suppressing information draws more attention to it
